name: Cable High-Pulley Curl
steps: Sit at a high pulley and take an underhand grip on its bar with your arms raised.
Keep your upper arms angled up and bend your elbows to curl the bar toward your forehead.
Slowly straighten your elbows to reach overhead again.
tips: Keep your elbows at the same height throughout the curl.
Keep your torso steady instead of leaning back to pull the bar down.
